scripts.asbuild:debug: mkdir -p build && asc assembly/index.ts --target debug --importMemory --outFile build/debug.wasm && mkdir -p public && cp build/debug.wasm public/debug.wasm
scripts.asbuild:release: mkdir -p build && asc assembly/index.ts --target release --importMemory --outFile build/release.wasm && mkdir -p public && cp build/release.wasm public/release.wasm
scripts.cpp:test:native: cmake -S cpp -B build/cpp-native -DTETRIS_CPP_NATIVE_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build/cpp-native && ctest --test-dir build/cpp-native --output-on-failure
scripts.build:all: npm run asbuild:release && npm run build:cpp && npm run build
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/validate-video-assets.mjs && node scripts/validate-block-material.mjs && node scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs
